customManagers.description: Update the kernel tag and its commit together. KERNEL_COMMIT sits between the comment and KERNEL_VERSION so the org dockerfileVersions and makefileVersions presets, which capture no digest, do not also match.

packageRules.description: Track 6.1 stable kernel tags (vX.Y.Z). Extracting drops rc tags. Never automerge: a reviewer checks the new commit against kernel.org before merge.
prBodyNotes:
Before merge, confirm that kernel.org prints `{{{newDigest}}}`:

```sh
git ls-remote https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/stable/linux.git 'refs/tags/v{{{newValue}}}^{}'
```
